sourceTitle: Strawberry Spinach Salad With Balsamic Vinaigrette
sourceText:
Strawberry Spinach Salad With Balsamic Vinaigrette
By: Cindy Mulligan
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 10:10am

Ingredients




For the Dressing:
4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar
2 tablespoons red wine vinegar
1 tablespoon Dijon mustard
2 teaspoons light brown sugar
2 smalls garlic cloves, minced
2 teaspoons poppy seeds
1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil
Salad –
1 package spinach leaves
1 pint strawberries, sliced
1/4 cup gorgonzola cheese (or bleu cheese)
Optional:
bacon, cooked and crumbled (I don't use)
grape tomatoes (I didn't use)
sliced red onion

Preparation

1 Mix the dressing ingredients together.In a small bowl, mix together the first 6 ingredients of the dressing. Slowly add the olive oil, while whisking vigorously to create an emulsion.
Add salt & pepper, to taste. 2 Just before serving toss the spinach and strawberries with the dressing.  Enjoy immediately.  This salad will not keep.

About


Spinach and Strawberries pair beautifully together—color-wise and flavor. The vinaigrette is one of the best you will ever taste.
